label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
reason: The compact weight implementation initially applied an effective-support covariance correction to every method. The historical ordinary bootstrap instead treats the 300 sampled occurrences as the sample and applies the exact fixed N/(N-1) correction even when item indices repeat.

correction_policy.A_ordinary_item_bootstrap: fixed occurrence count N=300; correction N/(N-1), exactly matching the historical implementation
correction_policy.E_controller_cluster: no item re-estimation; observed Dshape remains fixed

regression_test.invariant: count-weighted compact computation equals explicit repeated-index cross_block_shape within 1e-15
